title: The app is great
body:
I’ve had the app for a few years and I really like the look and feel and the simplicity of it. The only thing that I’d like to ask for is an option for not checking all the boxes when you complete an habit x times a week. For example, I want to exercise 3 times a week, if I exercise those 3 days, I’d like to get the “perfect” reward, but I still want to keep in my calendar the exact 3 days that I’ve exercised, and not check the whole week through (cause it’s not true that I’ve exercised everyday). Hope it’s understandable :)

Also including new report styles would be so cool, like a monthly theme style.

title: Con 3 días uso me encanta
body:
Como digo en el título, solo llevo 3 días de uso, pero en este tiempo lo que he podido ver me gusta y se ajusta a mis necesidades reales.

No le pongo aún las 5 estrellas porque quiero finalizar el periodo de prueba premium y valorar si adquiero la app. Pero creo que lo haré porque, por las funcionalidades que ofrece, el precio es muy bueno.

Sí tengo que decir en cuanto estética o personalización, que resulta un poco frustrante que algunos widgets puedan integrarse con el fondo de pantalla y otros no, quizás sería interesante que todos fueran compatibles con esta opción y que fuera un poco más intuitivo poder hacerlo.

Por aportar alguna idea adicional en cuanto a personalización o estética para futuras actualizaciones, creo que un widget con la daily quote estaría genial. ¡Y ya si os animáis a opción de lenguaje en español, sería un must!

Pero esto son mini cosillas en cuanto a estética, en lo que respecta a funcionalidad, a priori, me parece que todo está muy bien y se ajusta an mis necesidades. Editaré en cuanto la pruebe más días y agregue algunos hábitos más probando todas las funciones.

title: It’s good for the basics
body:
It’s a great app if you just want to track a couple habits by yourself, but once you get into more complicated stuff there’s more issues. Regarding the sharing function if you want to track a habit with a friend, it doesn’t always work: sometimes you mark stuff and the other person doesn’t see it and sometimes the whole habit sharing won’t even show. Also, the family premium feature is way too complicated to navigate: having to change settings on iCloud such as enabling purchase sharing and sharing subscriptions…
Also, customer support isn’t the best either. They either respond to half your messages or not at all or disappear after a couple of minutes of conversation…

title: 5 things I like about this App.
body:
1- It helps to track my steps, meditation, exercise, etc. It easily sync with my Apple health.

2- The countdown timer have various relaxing nature sounds that helps me focus as I build my habit of daily reading, and biblical prayer and meditation.

3- I also like the fact that I can set an end date for any habit that I am building.

4- I have also grouped some of my habits in the app based on the sections of my life. Like Health, Family, Time alone with God, etc 

5- Above all, in comparison with other apps I tried, the free version of this app is very robust. I decided to pay for this app to support whoever put this app together. 

In summary, THIS IS GOOD!

title: Affordable and complete
body:
Really happy with the app so far! I’ve used a lot of habit trackers before but they were either incomplete, ugly or /very/ expensive. This one has everything I need from an habit tracker (weekly, monthly options, stats…), is aesthetically pleasing and the best part: one-time payment option.

Missing a spanish version of the app though, hope they’ll consider adding a translation eventually.

title: Great app for habits with many options
body: I have been looking a while for an habit app that could really help me set and stick not just to daily habits but also to weekly and monthly habits, and I found it. With many customizable features (they have timers of your habit requires time, for example) and it’s visually appealing and quite user friendly. Oh! and you can set the period of time for which you want to the habit. I use this for small challenges. I really recommend this app if you are looking a tool to help you with your habits
